Ганцикловир C9H13N5O4 = 255.2. CAS — 82410-32-0. ATC — J05AB06; S01AD09. ATC Vet — QJ05AB06; QS01AD09. Pharmacopoeias. In Chin. and US. USP 31 (Ganciclovir). A white to off-white crystalline powder. Store at a temperature of 25°, excursions permitted between 15° and 30°. Ganciclovir Sodium (BANM, USAN, rINNM) Ganciclovir sódico; Ganciclovir Sodique; Natrii Ganciclovirum. Натрий Ганцикловир C9H12N5NaO4 = 277.2. CAS — 107910-75-8. ATC — J05AB06; S01AD09. ATC Vet — QJ05AB06; QS01AD09. Incompatibility. Ganciclovir is reported to be incompatible with foscarnet. Stability. Ganciclovir sodium solution in sodium chloride 0.9% was found1 to be stable when stored in polypropylene infusion- pump syringes for 12 hours at 25° and for 10 days at 4°. Little variation was found in ganciclovir concentration after storage of a 2% solution at room temperature, 5°, and −8° for 10 to 24 days.2 1. Mulye NV, et al. Stability of ganciclovir sodium in an infusion- pump syringe. Am J Hosp Pharm 1994; 51: 1348–9. 2. Morlet N, et al.
